module_summary: Virtual-FIFO AXI write side: per-segment async FIFOs cross input data into the AXI clock, a burst engine sizes writes by occupancy/timeout, and a response FIFO advances the finish pointer on B completions.

anchors.name: input_data
anchors.why: Segmented input data written into per-segment CDC FIFO memories

anchors.name: input_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment input valid gating FIFO write

anchors.name: input_ready
anchors.why: Per-segment ready, deasserted when segment FIFO is full or in reset

anchors.name: write_fifo_seg[*].seg_mem_data
anchors.why: Per-segment dual-clock FIFO memory buffering write data

anchors.name: write_fifo_seg[*].seg_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Per-segment write pointer in input clock domain, Gray-coded for crossing

anchors.name: write_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Shared write-FIFO read pointer in AXI clock domain

anchors.name: write_fifo_rd_ptr_gray_sync_2_reg
anchors.why: Synchronized Gray read pointer used for segment full detection

anchors.name: write_fifo_wr_ptr_sync_reg
anchors.why: Write pointer synchronized into AXI domain for empty and occupancy

anchors.name: write_fifo_occupancy_reg
anchors.why: Write FIFO occupancy deciding burst length and full-burst start

anchors.name: write_fifo_empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag gating reads into the output holding stage

anchors.name: input_valid_int_reg
anchors.why: Valid for read-out FIFO word; enables burst start and data transfer

anchors.name: input_read_en
anchors.why: Consumes FIFO output word when a write beat is issued

anchors.name: input_watermark
anchors.why: Input-side watermark when any segment exceeds watermark level

anchors.name: input_rst_out
anchors.why: Synchronized cfg reset into input clock domain, blocks input ready

anchors.name: wr_burst_reg
anchors.why: Two-state burst-active controller sequencing AW issue and W beats

anchors.name: wr_burst_len_reg
anchors.why: Remaining beats in current burst; generates wlast and ends burst

anchors.name: wr_timeout_count_reg
anchors.why: Partial-burst timeout counter reloaded when idle or AW pending

anchors.name: wr_timeout_reg
anchors.why: Timeout flag allowing a partial burst to start

anchors.name: fifo_full_wr_blk_adj_reg
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO full flag blocking new bursts; drives full status

anchors.name: wr_burst_len
anchors.why: Computed burst length limited by occupancy and burst boundary

anchors.name: wr_start_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO write start pointer; forms AXI address and occupancy

anchors.name: wr_start_ptr_blk_adj_reg
anchors.why: Block-aligned start pointer used for full detection

anchors.name: wr_finish_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write finish pointer advanced by completed burst lengths on bvalid

anchors.name: resp_fifo_burst_len
anchors.why: Response FIFO of outstanding burst lengths awaiting B completions

anchors.name: resp_fifo_we_reg
anchors.why: Writes burst length into response FIFO when burst starts

anchors.name: resp_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Response FIFO write pointer

anchors.name: resp_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Response FIFO read pointer advanced per completion

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write address from base address plus masked start pointer

anchors.name: m_axi_awlen
anchors.why: AXI burst length from computed burst length

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AW channel valid raised at burst start

anchors.name: m_axi_awready
anchors.why: AW channel ready clearing awvalid

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data from FIFO output word

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: W channel valid asserted per burst beat

anchors.name: m_axi_wready
anchors.why: W channel ready advancing write beats

anchors.name: m_axi_wlast
anchors.why: Last beat marker when burst counter reaches zero

anchors.name: m_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid advancing finish pointer and response FIFO

anchors.name: cfg_enable
anchors.why: Enables issuing new write bursts

anchors.name: cfg_fifo_base_addr
anchors.why: Base address of virtual FIFO region in AXI memory

anchors.name: cfg_fifo_size_mask
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO size mask for address wrap and full detection

anchors.name: rd_finish_ptr_in
anchors.why: Read-side finish pointer used for occupancy and full computation

anchors.name: sts_fifo_occupancy
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO occupancy output

anchors.name: sts_fifo_full
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO full status

anchors.name: sts_write_active
anchors.why: Active while burst or completions are outstanding

groups.name: input_cdc_fifo
groups.description: Per-segment dual-clock FIFOs with Gray pointer sync and reset synchronizer

groups.name: burst_engine
groups.description: Issues AW bursts by occupancy or timeout and streams W beats

groups.name: vfifo_pointers
groups.description: Virtual FIFO start/finish pointers and full detection
